The '''SLV-88''' was an aerosol used during the [[Galactic War]] that was formulated to control the minds and heighten the aggressive instincts of everyone exposed. On [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[SCORPIO]] used the gas to turn the group of attempted intruders into the [[Megasecurity Ward 23]] against each other.
